summary: 11 film announcements, 9 TV announcements across 5 trades.

film.title: Castle
film.announcement: Sony Pictures taps Jill Blankenship to pen medieval actioner Castle from an idea by Chris Bremner.

film.title: MotoGP Heist Thriller
film.announcement: Alan Ritchson and Fast & Furious scribe Chris Morgan team on MotoGP heist thriller at Netflix with Ritchson setting a film deal at the streamer.

film.title: Howl
film.announcement: Kumail Nanjiani's directing debut horror comedy Howl lands at Orion Pictures.

film.title: Runaway Wedding
film.announcement: Stephanie Laing to direct rom-com Runaway Wedding for Working Title.

film.title: Supermax
film.announcement: Jaafar Jackson joins Will Smith in action thriller Supermax.

film.title: Trust The Man
film.talent: Kate Mara, Finn Wittrock, Justice Smith, Victor Garber (cast)
film.announcement: Kate Mara, Finn Wittrock, Justice Smith and Victor Garber among final additions to Vietnam War thriller Trust The Man.

film.title: It Happened One Summer
film.announcement: Gavin Leatherwood joins Nina Dobrev in film adaptation of BookTok hit It Happened One Summer.

film.title: Pathetic Fallacy
film.talent: Scott Mescudi/Kid Cudi, Jessica Rothe, Travis Fimmel, Natasha Lyonne (cast), Adam Egypt Mortimer (director)
film.announcement: Scott Mescudi, Jessica Rothe, Travis Fimmel and Natasha Lyonne wrap on supernatural thriller Pathetic Fallacy from Adam Egypt Mortimer.

film.title: The Caged
film.talent: Tamzin Merchant, Edmund Kingsley, Raffiella Chapman (cast)
film.announcement: Saban Films takes North America for UK haunted house horror The Caged starring Tamzin Merchant, Edmund Kingsley and Raffiella Chapman.

film.title: Miss Navajo
film.announcement: Musical Miss Navajo in the works from director Billy Luther and singer-songwriter Raye Zaragoza.

film.title: V/H/S/MIXTAPE
film.talent: RZA, Ernest Dickerson, Flying Lotus (among contributors)
film.announcement: V/H/S/MIXTAPE set at Shudder as the ninth chapter of the horror anthology featuring RZA, Ernest Dickerson, Flying Lotus and more.

tv.title: God of War
tv.announcement: Dave Bautista in talks to play Kratos in God of War, replacing Ryan Hurst in Amazon series.

tv.title: DINKS
tv.talent: June Diane Raphael, Paul Scheer (stars), Marta Kauffman (creator)
tv.announcement: Amazon orders improvised multi-cam comedy DINKS starring June Diane Raphael and Paul Scheer from Marta Kauffman.

tv.title: The Poison Daughter
tv.announcement: The Poison Daughter romantasy novel getting Hulu series adaptation with author Sheila Masterson to EP.

tv.title: Warhammer 40,000
tv.announcement: Warhammer 40,000 animated series in works at Amazon with Henry Cavill to executive produce.

tv.title: Job Trafficking
tv.talent: Nimrat Kaur, Roshan Mathew, Pavan Malhotra (cast)
tv.announcement: Nimrat Kaur, Roshan Mathew and Pavan Malhotra star in Job Trafficking, Prime Video series about industrialized online scams.

tv.title: Task
tv.talent: Tim Blake Nelson, Jharrel Jerome, Bethlehem Million (season 2 cast additions)
tv.announcement: Task adds Tim Blake Nelson, Jharrel Jerome and Bethlehem Million among 6 cast additions for season 2.

tv.title: Scrabble
tv.announcement: Scrabble renewed by The CW for additional seasons.

tv.title: Trivial Pursuit
tv.announcement: Trivial Pursuit renewed by The CW for additional seasons.

tv.title: Police 24/7
tv.announcement: Police 24/7 renewed by The CW for additional seasons.
